messages.subject: Configure Shiny Server for Port 80
parts:
Would there be any problem with setting up a Shiny Server to listen on port 80? We run a small fantasy football site and use shiny apps to let our users do some statistical queries. But some users work in offices where their firewalls seem to block the apps. I was wondering if we should set up the server to just run on port 80 instead of whatever we have set up now.

We would probably move Shiny Server to its own VPS, so we could still use our main server to run nginx/wordpress configured for Port 80.

Does that make sense?
